label: explicit_diagnosis_compatible
rationale: Synovial sarcomas are explicitly named in conditions, consistent with open relapsed/refractory solid-tumor eligibility.

extra_biomarker_requirement: SSTR-PET within three months must show visual score at least 2 (uptake at least liver) in the majority of lesions. Positive SSTR imaging is unestablished by SS; no homologous-recombination mutation requirement is stated for olaparib.
protocol_uncertainty: External protocol and live slots are unverified. Olaparib dose and days differ between arm and intervention descriptions; preserve this unresolved regimen discrepancy. Prior treatment/washouts and all clinical criteria remain applicable.
quotes: Patients with scores ≥ 2 in the majority of the tumoral lesions will be considered to have a positive SSTR-PET and will be therefore eligible for the trial.

extra_biomarker_requirement: No additional molecular inclusion gate is stated.

quotes: Patients with a high-risk histiotype that is typically not graded, including adult pleomorphic rhabdomyosarcoma, synovial sarcoma, angiosarcoma, malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor, alveolar soft part sarcoma, epithelioid sarcoma, or clear cell sarcoma are eligible
